definitions.explanation: Seeking advice or discussing a matter with someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相談|そうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{相談|そうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧んですが。
examples.english: I have something I'd like to discuss with you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相談|そうだん}したら、⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦アドバイス→アドバイス：10699_adobaisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらえた→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When I consulted my boss about work, I got good advice.

notes:
{相談|そうだん} means consultation or discussion, typically seeking advice or input from others.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {相談|そうだん}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{相談|そうだん}する: to consult with someone
- {相談|そうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to give advice, to hear someone out
- {相談|そうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive consultation

COMPOUNDS:
- {相談|そうだん}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: person to consult with
- {相談|そうだん}⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: consultation desk/counter
- {相談|そうだん}⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: advisor, consultant
- ⟦{身の上|みのうえ}→身の上：18599_minoue⟧{相談|そうだん}: personal advice column

USEFUL EXPRESSION:
ちょっと{相談|そうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧んですが... (I have something I'd like to discuss with you...) - polite way to ask for advice.

USAGE:
{相談|そうだん} implies two-way discussion, not just asking a question.
